title: 第一章 飞龙岂是池中物第二章 什么是富可敌国
content_zh:
大学校内，德克士。
一个漂亮的长发女生，正一边吃着薯条，一边刷着手机，一边晃荡着白皙的长腿。
面前堆着烤翅、汉堡和橙汁。
旁边的桌子，一个男生正聚精会神的看着书自习，时不时的紧锁眉头，看样子似乎在思考深刻的知识。
这是典型的大学校园场景，悠闲的女生和刻苦的男生。
过了一会儿，女生伸了个懒腰，看了看面前的一堆食物，撅了撅嘴巴，起身离开了。
旁边的男生，目光顿时聚焦在刚才女生桌子上那堆吃剩了一半的食物上。
眼看四周无人，他身体一动，迅速的移动到了女生的位置上。
动作十分熟练，一看就很有经验了。
“妈的，真有钱，剩这么多东西，太浪费了，浪费是罪恶，哥来帮你解脱罪恶吧。”男生一边疯狂往嘴里塞女生吃剩的薯条，一边自言自语说道。
尽管橙汁女生喝剩的，显然男生也不在乎，往嘴里不停的输出。
但突然，男生似乎感觉到一股冷意，下意识就抬了头。
刚才那离开的女生，竟然不知何时已经回来了，此时正一脸惊恐的看着自己。
“天哪，你，你……我只是上个卫生间，你竟然偷吃我的东西……”女生真的不敢相信，是啊，现在这个社会，而且还是大学里，竟然还有人偷吃别人的东西？
有这么穷的人吗？
一些学生被惊动，纷纷投射来目光。
“对不起，对不起，”
男生很尴尬的站起来，在众人的注视下，匆忙离开了。
“我草，还以为已经不吃了呢，妈的，看来下次要确认对方已经完全离开才能去吃了。”出了德克士，男生自言自语的嘀咕道。
“唉，我陆原混到这个地步，还真是惨啊，要不是没钱吃饭了，谁他妈的干这种丢人的事啊。”

陆原叹了口气，摸摸肚子，好在刚才吃的快，算是混个半饱吧。回去歇会儿。
一进宿舍，迎面走来一个寸头男生，正是好哥们张辉。
“陆原，刚才李梦瑶来了，让把这个给你。”
张辉递过来一个oppo-R17手机。
见到手机，陆原心里不由一痛。
李梦瑶是自己前女友，三天前刚分手，李梦瑶提出来的。
这手机，当时候要三千多块，是自己在外面干了一个月的零工才攒够了钱，送给李梦瑶的生日礼物。
现在陆原还记得李梦瑶收到手机时候那种高兴的样子，想起来就挺甜蜜的。
现在，很显然手机被人家嫌弃丢还给了自己。
打开手机，屏保上是一行字。
“陆原，破手机还你了，因为我用不上，我男朋友给我买了苹果X，他很疼我，也有能力疼我，这一点，你永远比不上。”
呵呵，说到底，都是一个字，钱。
自己没钱。
“陆原，想开点。”
张辉说道，“我早就跟你说过，李梦瑶跟我们不是一路人，那货长得太漂亮，而且太风骚，长腿大胸网红脸，搔首弄姿，平时装的娇滴滴的，这种女人，都是给富二代们暖床的，我们普通人就别掺和了，不然最后痛苦吃亏的都是我们。”
“再说了，你不也是上过她了吗，你也不吃亏啊。”
content_en:
In the university campus, Dix.
A beautiful girl with long hair was eating French fries, scrolling through her phone, and swaying her long white legs.
Grilled wings, burgers and orange juice were piled in front of him.
At the table next to him, a boy was studying attentively in a book, frowning from time to time, as if he was thinking about profound knowledge.
This is a typical college campus scene, with laid-back girls and hard-working boys.
After a while, the girl stretched, looked at the pile of food in front of her, pouted, stood up and left.
The boy next to him suddenly focused his eyes on the half-eaten pile of food on the girl's table.
Seeing that there was no one around, he moved his body and quickly moved to the girl's position.
His movements are very skillful, and he looks very experienced at first glance.
"Damn, I'm so rich. It's such a waste to have so many things left. Waste is a sin. Let me help you get rid of your sin." The boy said to himself while crazily stuffing the girl's leftover French fries into his mouth.
Even though the girl drank the leftover orange juice, the boy obviously didn't care and kept pouring it into his mouth.
But suddenly, the boy seemed to feel a chill and subconsciously raised his head.
The girl who left just now came back unexpectedly and was looking at him with a look of horror on her face.
"Oh my God, you, you... I just went to the bathroom, and you actually ate my food..." The girl really couldn't believe it, yes, in today's society, and in college, there are still people who eat other people's things?
Are there any people so poor?
Some students were alarmed and looked at him one after another.
"I'm sorry, I'm sorry,"
The boy stood up awkwardly and left in a hurry under the gaze of everyone.
"Idiot, I thought I had stopped eating. Damn it, it seems that next time I have to make sure that the other person has completely left before I can eat." After getting out of Dicos, the boy muttered to himself.
"Oh, I, Lu Yuan, have gotten so miserable. If I didn't have money to eat, who the hell would do such a shameful thing?"
Lu Yuan sighed and touched his stomach. Fortunately, he ate quickly just now, so he was half full. Go back and take a rest.
As soon as I entered the dormitory, a boy with a short hair walked towards me, it was my good friend Zhang Hui.
"Lu Yuan, Li Mengyao came just now and asked me to give you this."
Zhang Hui handed over an oppo-R17 mobile phone.
Seeing the mobile phone, Lu Yuan couldn't help but feel a pain in his heart.
Li Mengyao was his ex-girlfriend. They just broke up three days ago, and Li Mengyao brought it up.
This mobile phone cost more than 3,000 yuan at the time. I worked odd jobs outside for a month to save enough money and gave it to Li Mengyao as a birthday gift.
Now Lu Yuan still remembers Li Mengyao's happy look when he received the mobile phone. It's quite sweet to think about it.
Now, it is obvious that the mobile phone was thrown back to me after being rejected.
When you turn on your phone, there is a line of text on the screen saver.
"Lu Yuan, I returned the broken phone to you because I can't use it. My boyfriend bought me an Apple X. He loves me very much and has the ability to love me. You will never be able to compare to this."
Haha, in the end, it all comes down to one word, money.
I have no money.
"Lu Yuan, be more open-minded."
Zhang Hui said, "I have told you a long time ago that Li Mengyao is not from the same group as us. She is too beautiful and coquettish. She has long legs and big breasts and is an internet celebrity. She is flirtatious and looks cute in her everyday clothes. This kind of woman warms the bed of the rich second generation. We ordinary people should not get involved, otherwise we will be the ones who suffer in the end."
"Besides, didn't you also have sex with her? You won't suffer any loss."
